image_prompts.purpose: Week 6 opener board for quick recognition of color, silhouette, and visual impression differences.
image_prompts.visual_description: A compact board with four adult-oriented fashion looks or sketches that are visually distinct in palette and silhouette: one black-and-white contrast look, one warm soft look, one cool long look, and one bright playful look.
image_prompts.style_instructions: Use a polished fashion-education illustration or fashion-sketch style with strong clarity and adult proportions.
image_prompts.composition_notes: Keep the four looks separated and easy to scan on mobile. Emphasize clear color differences and silhouette differences over background detail.
image_prompts.avoid: Avoid logos, dense backgrounds, childlike cartoon proportions, and cluttered moodboard-style layouts.

image_prompts.purpose: Color vocabulary and palette board for the main Week 6 color-matching task.
image_prompts.visual_description: One clear educational board combining six basic color swatches and six palette cards. Visible key A is black, B is white, C is red, D is blue, E is green, F is yellow, G is warm palette, H is cool palette, I is neutral palette, J is bright palette, K is soft palette, and L is monochrome palette.
image_prompts.style_instructions: Use a clean educational design with high-contrast swatches and simple look cards that read well on a phone screen.
image_prompts.composition_notes: Keep each key A to L large and easy to read. Make the palette cards visually obvious, with no ambiguous color families.
image_prompts.text_in_image: Only the visible keys A to L.
image_prompts.avoid: Avoid decorative typography, extra keys, extra palette labels, and color combinations that blur warm, cool, soft, and bright distinctions.

image_prompts.purpose: Shape, line, and silhouette board for the main Week 6 visual-vocabulary task.
image_prompts.visual_description: One clean board combining line examples and silhouette examples. Visible key A is straight line, B is curved line, C is vertical line, D is horizontal line, E is diagonal line, F is fitted silhouette, G is loose silhouette, H is straight silhouette, I is flared silhouette, J is oversized jacket, and K is cropped top.
image_prompts.style_instructions: Use a polished fashion-education visual style with simple diagrams and clean garment silhouettes.
image_prompts.composition_notes: Separate the line diagrams from the garment silhouettes while keeping all keys A to K visible and unambiguous. Optimize for mobile readability and direct answer-key matching.
image_prompts.text_in_image: Only the visible keys A to K.
image_prompts.avoid: Avoid extra arrows, extra labels, tiny details, or overlapping silhouettes that make matching unclear.

image_prompts.purpose: Three-look reading gallery for matching short visual descriptions to keyed images.
image_prompts.visual_description: A gallery with three clearly separated adult-oriented fashion looks labeled only as image A, image B, and image C. Image A shows a black-and-white look with a straight silhouette and strong contrast. Image B shows a soft warm look with a light orange and beige dress, loose silhouette, and curved lines. Image C shows a bright look with a pink top, wide blue pants, and a cropped top silhouette.
image_prompts.style_instructions: Use a clean fashion-sketch or polished editorial-education hybrid style with strong silhouette and color readability.
image_prompts.composition_notes: Make the three looks easy to compare. The visible image keys A, B, and C must be clear and the looks must align exactly with the reading task details.
image_prompts.text_in_image: Only the visible image keys A, B, and C.
image_prompts.avoid: Avoid background scenes, decorative text, or any garment details that contradict the reading descriptions.

image_prompts.purpose: Reusable four-look gallery for listening, writing, and speaking.
image_prompts.visual_description: A gallery with four clearly separated fashion looks labeled only as image A, image B, image C, and image D. Image A shows a cool look with blue and green colors and a long straight silhouette. Image B shows a black-and-white contrast look with an oversized jacket and narrow pants. Image C shows a look with a flared skirt, a soft pink blouse, and curved lines. Image D shows a bright and playful look with a yellow top, orange shorts, and simple lines.
image_prompts.style_instructions: Use a clean adult-oriented fashion-sketch gallery style with strong color contrast and easy comparison.
image_prompts.composition_notes: Keep the four looks visually distinct and evenly spaced. The gallery must support exact answer-key matching across listening, writing, and speaking tasks.
image_prompts.text_in_image: Only the visible image keys A, B, C, and D.
image_prompts.avoid: Avoid extra decorative text, ambiguous colors, cluttered backgrounds, or details that conflict with the Week 6 listening script.
